pages.title: Frostite
pages.text:
Ice-cold gear from the frozen peaks.

- **Tier:** Diamond
- **Durability:** 1400
- **Sword damage:** 6.5
- **Armor (full set):** 18

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: **Frostite Ore** grows inside the packed ice and blue ice of **Frozen Peaks** and **Ice Spikes**. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw frostite.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Frostbite:** frostite swords, spears, and axes slow what they hit and build up freezing, like powder snow. A few hits freeze a mob solid.
- **Insulated:** wearing any piece of frostite armor stops you from freezing.
- **Snow Walker:** frostite boots walk on powder snow, like leather boots.
- **Rime:** blocking a melee attack with the frostite shield slows the attacker.

pages.title: Permafrost
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** Melee attackers are slowed, and sprinting along still water freezes it underfoot (it melts again soon after), like a weaker Frost Walker.
A blast furnace works too, and is faster.
